reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Washington
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate mobile/manufactured home landlords?"

    We treat "explicitly regulate" as: the landlord-tenant/eviction-related statutory scheme
    expressly addresses mobile/manufactured homes or mobile home park landlords in its text
    (e.g., by defining "landlord" specifically for mobile home parks, or by including mobile
    homes within covered dwelling units).
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(washington).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

/* scenario_statement/0
   Succeeds when the encoded factual statement for this QA is in place.
*/
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(washington),
    scenario_focus_year(2021).

% -----------------------------
% Statute applicability (as provided)
% -----------------------------

/* statute_in_force(State, Year, StatuteId). */
statute_in_force(washington, 2021, rcw_59_18_030).
statute_in_force(washington, 2021, rcw_59_20_030).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% -----------------------------

/* RCW 59.18.030 (2021) - Definitions (Residential Landlord-Tenant Act)
   Key portion for this question:
   "Dwelling unit" includes ... "mobile homes".  (subsection (10))
*/
statute_rcw_59_18_030_dwelling_unit_includes(mobile_home) :- !.

% Also relevant context: RCW 59.18.030 defines landlord broadly (subsection (16)).
statute_rcw_59_18_030_defines_landlord_as(owner_lessor_or_sublessor_of_dwelling_unit_or_property) :- !.


/* RCW 59.20.030 (2021) - Definitions (Mobile Home Park Landlord-Tenant Act)
   Key portion for this question:
   "Landlord" means the owner of a mobile home park and includes the agents of a landlord. (subsection (6))
   Definitions also expressly define manufactured home and mobile home. (subsections (8) and (10))
*/
statute_rcw_59_20_030_defines_landlord_as_owner_of_mobile_home_park :- !.
statute_rcw_59_20_030_defines_home_type(manufactured_home) :- !.
statute_rcw_59_20_030_defines_home_type(mobile_home) :- !.

% -----------------------------
% Helper predicates: detect explicit regulation of mobile/manufactured home landlords
% -----------------------------

/* explicit_mobile_home_landlord_regulation(State, Year)
   True if the statutory scheme expressly speaks to mobile/manufactured home landlords.
*/
explicit_mobile_home_landlord_regulation(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_force(State, Year, rcw_59_20_030),
    statute_rcw_59_20_030_defines_landlord_as_owner_of_mobile_home_park,
    !.

explicit_mobile_home_landlord_regulation(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_force(State, Year, rcw_59_18_030),
    statute_rcw_59_18_030_dwelling_unit_includes(mobile_home),
    statute_rcw_59_18_030_defines_landlord_as(owner_lessor_or_sublessor_of_dwelling_unit_or_property),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    (   scenario_statement,
        scenario_state(State),
        scenario_focus_year(Year),
        explicit_mobile_home_landlord_regulation(State, Year)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate mobile/manufactured home landlords?
